text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Campaign for local council elections gives chance to all political parties to express themselves through the media.
- Edem Kodjo, former secretary-general of Organisation of African Unity, says Saharan Arab Democratic Republic (SADR) no longer meets the conditions that favoured it support.
- Istiqlal party leader says only truly representative local councils will put democracy on a solid basis.
- Iron causes fire in Casablanca flat after maid left it plugged in.
- Unemployed graduates, pressing for jobs, pin hopes on Prime Minister Abdellatif Filali's promise that a solution will be found by mid-June.
- Mohamed Yazghi, leader of Socialist Union of People's Forces (USFP), says party hopes to be example of clean democracy in the Maghreb and the Arab world.
